articles.title: AIIMS Paramedical 2026 Admit Card released at aiimsexams.ac.in; direct link and download steps

articles.title: Drones instead of new destroyers for ageing fleet tipped to dominate delayed military plan - with claims new Defence Secretary has won £1billion extra from Treasury
articles.summary: The Royal Navy's plans to replace its aging destroyers and frigates are reportedly being shelved. Instead, the UK government is prioritizing defence investment towards drones and other autonomous weapon systems. This strategic shift aims to modernize naval capabilities by leveraging advanced technology, reflecting a significant move towards future warfare concepts and resource allocation in military innovation.

articles.title: WSL: Victoria Pelova departs Arsenal and joins North London rivals Tottenham Hotspur
articles.summary: Dutch international midfielder Victoria Pelova, 27, has signed with Tottenham Hotspur, joining the Lilywhites after her contract expired with Arsenal. This significant transfer sees a seasoned player move between rival clubs, strengthening Tottenham's squad in women's football. Her addition is expected to boost the team's midfield capabilities for the upcoming season.
